item.text:
I ran a broad, deduplicated discovery pass across Kremlin, ICC, OSCE, OHCHR/UN, ICRC, HRW, Amnesty, SIPRI, and Reuters/ReutersConnect families, plus Russian-language variants. I did not open the source pages in this pass, so every entry below is `search-hit only`, not read-confirmed. The web tool hit its search-call ceiling before I could saturate to 100, so the pool below is the largest verified set I could assemble without inventing entries.

**Query families attempted**
- Kremlin official site exact-title, by-date archive, speeches, statements, articles, interviews, and legal-order searches in English and Russian.
- ICC situation/news/statement searches for the Ukraine situation, arrest warrants, and accountability statements.
- OSCE Moscow Mechanism, ODIHR interim report, and Permanent Council searches.
- OHCHR/HRMMU searches for civilian harm, detention, occupied territory, and POW reports.
- UN General Assembly, Secretary-General, and Commission of Inquiry searches on Ukraine.
- ICRC searches on Russia-Ukraine humanitarian response, detention, and Olenivka.
- HRW, Amnesty, and SIPRI searches on war crimes, civilian harm, children, and military expenditure.
- Reuters / ReutersConnect / Reuters syndication searches on ICC warrant, mutiny, mobilization, grain deal, peace talks, nuclear signaling, budget, and Valdai.
- Russian-language equivalents of the above where possible.
